about_the_game:
Survive alone against a never ending horde of undead! How long can you survive?

Quarantine City is a simple 2D bullet-hell game where you can explore the city, find guns, and kill as many zombies as possible!

After a recent outbreak at a nearby military facility, all citizens are ordered to evacuate the city before 10Am.. However; you overslept.. Now you must battle an endless horde of infection and survive as long as you can!

I created this game in a few months with my own game engine written with C++. While the pixel art is an accumulation of years of hand-drawn work, some of the pixel art orignially came from OpenGameArt, however; was edited extensively to fit my design.

Players can walk around using WSAD keys and aim/fire their weapons using their mouse! Simply bump into doors and crates to open them and using G will allow you to pick up new weapons. Pressing P will allow you to pause the game.

Zombies will drop ammo and antidote's to help keep your ammo replinished and infection level low.

Players can adjust their audio settings once the game has started.

Would you like to see additional features? Please let me know!

This game was created by a solo-developer using no game engine!

content_descriptors.notes: Pixelated gore, guns, and killing / shooting zombies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon II or better)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible GPU with at least 256 MB VRAM (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce 600 series / AMD Radeon HD 7000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No.
